title: Helwit Cherry Nicotine Pouches 9mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Cherry Nicotine Pouches offer a deep, fruity flavour with a soft sweetness and light tang. This take on Cherry is more mellow than candy-like, making it a comfortable all-day option for users who enjoy richer fruit notes without excess sharpness. It’s a quietly flavourful pouch that feels both classic and contemporary. Made with soft plant-based fibres, each slim pouch fits comfortably under the lip for discreet use at work, on the move or in social settings. The 9mg nicotine strength delivers a consistent and satisfying experience with no smoke, vapour or odour. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
